items.body: The urial sheep of Shiraz, a distinctive blend of Armenian and Larestan wild sheep, inhabits the rocky highlands of Fars Province, particularly Bamu National Park northeast of Shiraz. The species plays an important role in maintaining ecological balance, regulating vegetation and supporting the survival of endangered predators such as the Persian leopard and Asiatic cheetah.

items.body: Census takers visit households in Tehran’s Pasteur neighborhood to collect information during the 1986 national population and housing census. Within its walls, residents created a self-sustaining community with its own infrastructure, taxes, and even an elected president. Despite challenging living conditions, those who moved out into proper apartments are nostalgic about their time in the tower. However...

A high-rise with panoramic views right in the center of Caracas — but there’s a catch. The building was never finished because of the crisis. People who had nowhere else to go made it their home. For several years, they lived among bare concrete walls. In 2015, the residents were relocated. Their story lives on in the film ‘Occupy Tower’ (2015). FOLLOW 🥰 News&Docfilms Channel

items.body: Saudi Arabia's energy minister on Monday said the country had been tested but would mount a "serious" response after a string of attacks on Riyadh's international airport by Yemen's Houthis that left 18 people dead. Lethal airport strikes since last week have rocked the world's top oil exporter, which is pursuing an expensive economic reform drive aimed at attracting foreign investment.

items.body: The concerts of several singers accused of supporting the regime of deposed president Bashar al-Assad have been cancelled this summer in Syria. One of the musicians later publicly apologised.

items.body: An Indonesian citizen on the crew of an Ethiopian Airlines cargo flight from Addis Ababa to Ben Gurion got the aircraft denied entry into Israeli airspace and sent back. The crew list only reached Israeli systems after the plane had already taken off early in the morning. The nationality was flagged and the order to turn around followed. Indonesia and Israel hold no diplomatic relations. Kipa.
